item_titles: Shopify says AI search is driving more traffic and sales, not replacing Google

item_titles: 倒卖英伟达GPU算力比火箭卫星来钱快！马斯克交出SpaceX首份财报
SpaceX’s ambitious compute goals could require over two million Nvidia Rubin GPUs
SpaceX has bought $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks so far this year

clusters.title: SpaceX大举扩张AI算力并购买特斯拉Megapacks储能设备
